paths.name: axios
paths.message: apps/web must not call axios directly — business logic and API calls live in @jayedaad/core (viewmodels/services). See Jayedaad_Architectural_Blueprint.md §2.

paths.name: @supabase/supabase-js
paths.message: apps/web must not use the plain Supabase client directly — use useAuthViewModel() from @jayedaad/core. @supabase/ssr (a different package, not restricted here) is the sanctioned exception in middleware.ts and providers.tsx, since only it produces a cookie-backed session middleware can read.

patterns.message: Import from '@jayedaad/core' (the package root) instead of its internal files — only the public barrel export is a stable contract.
